label: Telegram
description: Chat with sijba through your own Telegram bot. Only chats you pair with a code can use it.

fields.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
fields.label: Bot token
fields.help: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste the token it gives you.

fields.name: TELEGRAM_PAIRING_CODE
fields.label: Pairing code
fields.help: Choose a code. Then send /pair <code> to your bot from each chat that may use sijba.

fields.name: TELEGRAM_TARGET
fields.label: Send messages to
fields.help: Optional handler or channel id. Empty: the normal pipeline decides.
